articles.title: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
articles.description: Pike was convicted and sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.
articles.titleJa: 米国人殺人犯クリスタ・パイクの処刑が直前に中止
articles.summary: 米国の殺人犯クリスタ・パイクの処刑が、直前になって中止された。彼女は1996年に殺人罪で死刑を宣告されていた。

articles.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
articles.description: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、春以降最大規模のウクライナ電力インフラ攻撃を開始
articles.summary: ロシアがウクライナの電力インフラに対し、春以降最大規模の攻撃を行った。国内11地域が標的となり、住宅や鉄道も被害を受けた。

articles.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends
articles.description: The withdrawal of coalition forces, under a deal agreed two years ago, was a key demand of the Iraqi government.
articles.titleJa: 対イスラム国作戦終了に伴い、英米軍がイラクから撤退
articles.summary: 2年前の合意に基づき、英米の連合軍がイラクからの撤退を完了した。これはイラク政府の主要な要求だった。

articles.title: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
articles.description: Mindgard said it discovered in July that Kimi models K2.6 and K3 Swarm could evade developer's safety limits.
articles.titleJa: 中国のAIツールが生物兵器の製造方法を研究者に提示
articles.summary: 中国のAIツール「Kimi」が、開発者の安全制限を回避し、研究者に生物兵器の製造方法を伝えたことが判明した。

articles.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
articles.description: Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.
articles.titleJa: ガザでの攻撃後、少女が感染症治療のため複数回の手術を受ける
articles.summary: ガザでの攻撃により、ラシールちゃんのテントがイスラエル軍ヘリの攻撃を受け、彼女は感染症治療のため複数回の手術を受けた。

articles.title: US actor Chad Lowe 'heartbroken' by death of daughter Fiona aged 13
articles.description: Lowe and his wife Kim Painter announce the death of their daughter, who "was the light of our lives".
articles.titleJa: 米国俳優チャド・ロウ、13歳の娘フィオナさんの死に「心が張り裂ける」
articles.summary: 米国俳優チャド・ロウが、13歳の娘フィオナさんの死に深い悲しみを表明。「彼女は私たちの人生の光だった」と語った。

articles.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
articles.description: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.
articles.titleJa: シンガポール、公務員向けお見合いサービスを開始
articles.summary: シンガポールは、記録的な出生率の低さに対応するため、公務員向けのお見合いサービス「FirstDate」を開始した。

articles.title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
articles.description: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.
articles.titleJa: アフリカ一の富豪、土地抗議にもかかわらずケニアで石油精製所を稼働
articles.summary: アフリカ一の富豪が、土地の抗議活動にもかかわらずケニアで石油精製所を稼働させた。これはアフリカの工業化を目指す計画の一部。

articles.title: 'He will never walk free': Indian judge's letter promises child sex abuse survivor
articles.description: In the emotional letter, the judge describes the survivor as "the bravest little girl this court has ever seen".
articles.titleJa: 「彼は決して自由にはならない」：インド人判事が児童性的虐待の生存者に約束する書簡
articles.summary: インドの判事が、児童性的虐待の生存者へ「彼は決して自由にならない」と約束する書簡を送った。判事は彼女を「これまで見た中で最も勇敢な少女」と称賛。

articles.title: Botswana condemned for slaughtering 23 elephants for independence celebrations
articles.description: The government authorises the hunting of elephants and dozens of other wild animals for independence day feasts.
articles.titleJa: ボツワナ、独立記念日祝賀会のためにゾウ23頭を虐殺し非難される
articles.summary: ボツワナ政府が独立記念日の祝宴のためにゾウ23頭と他の野生動物を狩猟したことで、国際的な非難を浴びている。

articles.title: Senegal's Youth Olympics makes Olympics in Africa 'logical'
articles.description: The Youth Olympics are to be hosted in Africa for the first time ever. The edition in Senegal is also a chance to prove the continent can host a full Olympics in the future.
articles.titleJa: セネガルのユースオリンピック、アフリカでのオリンピック開催を「論理的」に
articles.summary: セネガルで初めてアフリカ大陸がユースオリンピックを開催。これは将来的にアフリカが本格的なオリンピックを誘致できる可能性を示すものとなる。

articles.title: African leaders herald $16B Dangote oil refinery in Kenya
articles.description: An oil refinery on Kenya's coast is expected to be completed in 40 months, and will process an estimated 700,000 barrels of oil per day. Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote, will lead the project.
articles.titleJa: アフリカ首脳、ケニアの160億ドルのダングーテ製油所を歓迎
articles.summary: ケニア沿岸で160億ドル規模の石油精製所が建設され、アフリカ経済に大きな影響を与える見込み。アフリカ一の富豪がプロジェクトを主導する。

articles.title: Flydubai pilot investigated over possible attempt to crash Tel Aviv-bound flight
articles.description: A Flydubai service from the UAE to Israel made an emergency landing after one pilot stabbed another. Officials are investigating whether this was a deliberate attempt to crash the plane.
articles.titleJa: フライ・ドバイのパイロット、テルアビブ行き便墜落未遂の疑いで調査中
articles.summary: UAE発イスラエル行き便でパイロットが別のパイロットを刺し、緊急着陸。意図的な墜落未遂の可能性が捜査されている。

articles.title: Germany raises Deutschlandticket price to €66.80 a month from 2027 under new cost-based formula
articles.description: A new cost-based formula has pushed up the price of Germany's nationwide public transport pass for 2027.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ、新費用ベース方式で2027年からドイチュラントチケット価格を月額66.80ユーロに引き上げ
articles.summary: ドイツの全国公共交通パス「ドイチュラントチケット」の価格が、新たな費用計算方式により2027年から月額66.80ユーロに引き上げられる。

articles.title: Iran's nuclear program remains shrouded in mystery as the regime debates ditching non-proliferation
articles.description: Iran's nuclear program is entering a critical phase as Tehran debates dropping out of a nuclear non-proliferation treaty. Satellite images also show activity at known nuclear sites.
articles.titleJa: イランの核開発計画、不拡散条約脱退を議論する中、依然として謎に包まれる
articles.summary: イランの核開発計画が重要な局面を迎え、政権は核不拡散条約からの脱退を検討。衛星画像からも核施設での活動が示されている。

articles.title: The lawyer of Junaid Hafeez, a Fullbright scholar imprisoned for 13 years in a Pakistani jail, is hopeful for his release
articles.description: A former Fullbright scholar, Junaid Hafeez was sentenced to death under Pakistan's controversial blasphemy laws. His family and lawyer told DW there is now hope a court will overturn the conviction.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンの刑務所に13年間収監されたフルブライト奨学生ジュネイド・ハフィーズの弁護士、釈放に希望を抱く
articles.summary: パキスタンの冒涜法により死刑を宣告された元フルブライト奨学生ジュネイド・ハフィーズの弁護士が、判決が覆され釈放されることに希望を抱いている。

articles.title: Manchester City Premier League charges: What do they mean?
articles.description: Since being bought by the UAE in 2008, Manchester City have become one of the world's most successful football clubs. A raft of serious financial charges threatens to undermine this and bring chaos to the Premier League.
articles.titleJa: マンチェスター・シティのプレミアリーグ告発：その意味するところとは？
articles.summary: マンチェスター・シティに対する深刻な財政違反の告発が、クラブの成功とプレミアリーグに混乱をもたらす可能性があり、その影響が注目されている。

articles.title: Servers at Munich's iconic Oktoberfest call for more respect
articles.description: Oktoberfest is famous the world over for beer, brass band music and Bavarian traditions. But staff at the Wiesn are also reporting incidents of racism and sexism. They're taking a stand against discrimination.
articles.titleJa: ミュンヘンの象徴的なオクトーバーフェストの従業員がより多くの敬意を求める
articles.summary: 世界的に有名なオクトーバーフェストで、従業員が人種差別や性差別を報告し、差別撤廃を求めている。

articles.title: Bosnia elections: Polls overshadowed by exhaustion, exodus and geopolitics as ethnic politics eclipse real problems
articles.description: Bosnia goes to the polls on October 4 to elect several parliaments and presidents. While voters worry about the economy and emigration, the campaign is focused on ethnicity, exposing the country's political paralysis.
articles.titleJa: ボスニア選挙：疲弊、流出、地政学が影を落とす中、民族政治が真の問題を覆い隠す
articles.summary: ボスニアの選挙では、有権者が経済や移民に懸念を抱く一方、民族問題に焦点を当てた選挙運動が行われ、国の政治的麻痺を露呈している。

articles.title: Is US President Donald Trump right to rename AI as 'Super Intelligence'?
articles.description: Donald Trump thinks the name artificial intelligence sounds "fake" and has ordered US agencies to use "Super Intelligence" instead. Yet, tech firms and researchers have little reason to play along.
articles.titleJa: ドナルド・トランプ米大統領はAIを「スーパーインテリジェンス」と改名するのが正しいのか？
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプ米大統領は、AIという名称が「偽物」に聞こえるため「スーパーインテリジェンス」への改名を指示したが、技術企業や研究者は賛同する理由が少ない。

articles.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda
articles.description:
Support for white Afrikaners, anti-communism and others reveals how US redefining what qualifies as human rights
With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court, and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.
On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests to not do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The Guardian has reached out to the state department for comment on whether it had “blown” holds from Congress on releasing the funds due to concerns about their use.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ政権、人権資金を極右の政策推進に転用
articles.summary: トランプ政権は、期限切れ間近の人権資金1億7500万ドル超を、反共産主義基金や南アフリカの白人アフリカーナーの権利擁護、ブラジル最高裁への反対運動など、極右的な政策推進に充てることを決定しました。議会の懸念にもかかわらず資金は拠出されました。

articles.title: South African leader urges men to speak up on gender-based violence after series of killings
articles.description:
President announces measures amid anger at authorities over recent murders of women
South Africa’s president has called on men to take more responsibility for violence against women as he announced measures to tackle the problem, amid anger at authorities over a recent wave of murders.
Cyril Ramaphosa acknowledged that not enough had been done to protect women. He said police would be reviewing unsolved murders, attempted murders and serious sexual offences against women and children, as well as producing a funded plan to reduce the forensic backlog for such cases, both within 60 days.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ大統領、相次ぐ殺害事件を受け男性にジェンダーに基づく暴力への発言を促す
articles.summary: 南アフリカのラマポーザ大統領は、相次ぐ女性殺害事件を受け、ジェンダーに基づく暴力対策を強化するため、男性がより責任を持つよう求めました。未解決事件の再調査や法医学鑑定の滞り解消計画などを発表。

articles.title: Burundi agrees to receive ‘third-country’ migrant deportees from US
articles.description:
Burundi joins several other African nations in accepting people deported under Trump’s hardline policy
Burundi has agreed to join a clutch of ⁠other African nations in receiving migrants from other countries deported from the US under ⁠Donald Trump’s hardline ⁠immigration ​policy.
However, the authorities in Bujumbura, the country’s economic capital, said Burundi will only accept those not accused of crime or terrorism links, said ⁠Nancy Ninette Mutoni, a spokesperson for the country’s president, Évariste Ndayishimiye. Tuesday’s announcement gave no details of numbers, timing or financial ⁠details.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブルンジ、米国からの「第三国」移民送還者受け入れに同意
articles.summary: ブルンジが、トランプ政権の厳しい移民政策の下、米国から送還される第三国の移民を受け入れることに同意しました。ただし、犯罪やテロ関連の容疑がない者に限定すると発表。詳細な人数や時期は不明です。

articles.title: DRC politician beaten to death after radio appearance about Ebola outbreak
articles.description:
Marie-Celestin Karondwa was attacked on Sunday after promoting measures to prevent spread of disease, his party says

A senior member of the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s ruling party was beaten to death on Sunday after appearing on a radio programme to raise awareness about the Ebola outbreak, a party representative has said.
Marie-Celestin Karondwa, the acting president of the Union for Democracy and Social Progress (UDPS) party’s federal executive committee in Butembo, a new hotspot for the outbreak, was attacked after taking part in a ​radio show during which he ‌promoted prevention measures for the disease, ‌the UDPS federation in the city said in a statement, Reuters reported.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国の政治家、エボラ出血熱に関するラジオ出演後に撲殺される
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国の与党幹部が、エボラ出血熱の予防措置についてラジオ番組で啓発活動を行った後、撲殺されました。ブテンボ市で発生し、同地のエボラ対策における緊張が浮き彫りになっています。

articles.title: At least 27 dead after two mass shootings in South Africa, police say
articles.description:
Seventeen people killed near Johannesburg in suspected ‘illegal goldmining turf war’, as 10 killed in separate incident at barbecue venue near Cape Town
Two separate mass shootings near South Africa’s two biggest cities killed at least 27 people, as the country grapples with one of the world’s highest murder rates amid investigations into corruption and criminality within the police.
The South African police service said on Sunday that 17 people were killed on Saturday night when eight suspects armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols opened fire at a bar in Wedela township, about 50 miles south-west of central Johannesburg. At least 15 other people sustained gunshot injuries in that attack, police said.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカで2つの銃乱射事件により少なくとも27人死亡と警察発表
articles.summary: 南アフリカの2大都市近郊で別々に発生した2件の銃乱射事件により、少なくとも27人が死亡しました。ヨハネスブルグ近郊で17人、ケープタウン近郊で10人が殺害され、警察は捜査を進めています。

articles.title: Mighty Sparrow, the Trinidad and Tobago singer known as the ‘calypso king of the world’, dies aged 91
articles.description:
Slinger Francisco, who performed as the Mighty Sparrow, died on Sunday surrounded by family in New York
Slinger Francisco, known on stage as the Mighty Sparrow and dubbed the “calypso king of the world”, has died aged 91.
Francisco, who got his breakthrough in calypso music with his 1956 hit song Jean and Dinah, died peacefully surrounded by his family in New York on Sunday, his family said in a statement.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「カリプソの王」として知られるトリニダード・トバゴの歌手マイティ・スパロウが91歳で死去
articles.summary: 「カリプソの王」として世界的に知られるトリニダード・トバゴ出身の歌手、マイティ・スパロウことスリンガー・フランシスコが91歳で亡くなりました。1956年のヒット曲「ジーン・アンド・ダイナ」でブレイクし、家族に見守られ安らかに息を引き取ったとのことです。

articles.title: Hurricane Nolo still threatens Hawaii as Mexico’s Baja braces for Hurricane Polo
articles.description:
Hurricane Nolo is moving away from Hawaiian islands but threat of heavy rain, flash floods and strong winds persists
Hurricane Nolo was moving away from the Hawaiian islands on Sunday, but the threat of heavy rain, flash flooding and strong winds persisted in areas of the island chain still recovering from previous storms.
Nolo was about 365 miles (585km) south-south-west of Honolulu and moving away from the Big Island at about 12mph (19km/h). But the Hawaii county civil defense agency said a high wind warning, wind advisory and high surf advisory remained in effect for parts of the island through Sunday evening as Nolo’s maximum sustained winds rose to 115mph.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ハリケーン・ノロがハワイを依然脅かし、メキシコのバハはハリケーン・ポロに備える
articles.summary: ハリケーン・ノロはハワイ諸島から離れつつありますが、豪雨、鉄砲水、強風の脅威は残っています。一方、メキシコのバハ半島はハリケーン・ポロに備え、両地域で警戒が続いています。

articles.title: Melbourne man’s mysterious disappearance on popular Peru hiking trail prompts widespread search
articles.description:
Loved ones describe Jordan Yap, 30, as an experienced hiker who set out for a 10-day solo trek Peru before falling silent

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Loved ones of a missing Australian trekker who was last seen nearly two weeks ago on a remote South American hiking trail are urging local authorities to help with the search.
A wide-scale sweep by a private rescue crew has so far failed to find any trace of 30-year-old Jordan Yap, who last made contact with friends and family on 14 September ahead of a planned 10-day solo trek along Peru’s Huayhuash mountain range, 400km north-east of Lima.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 人気のペルートレッキングルートでメルボルン人男性が謎の失踪、大規模な捜索が行われる
articles.summary: 経験豊富なハイカーであるメルボルン出身のジョーダン・ヤップ氏（30歳）が、ペルーのワイヤッシュ山脈での単独トレッキング中に消息を絶ちました。友人と家族は大規模な捜索を当局に要請しています。

articles.title: US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but Trump admin not wavering
articles.description:
Attorney says fishers ‘losing their livelihoods’, but Marco Rubio maintains US still willing to ‘blow up ships if need be’
While the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, was being decorated in Quito by Ecuador’s president for “helping to promote peace in the region”, 10 Ecuadorian fishers whose boat had been blown up by US forces were adrift in the eastern Pacific.
On 8 September, a day before Rubio arrived, a US patrol vessel intercepted the fishing boat Don Rufo in international waters near Ecuador.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国によるエクアドル漁船への攻撃が人道上の懸念を引き起こすも、トランプ政権は揺るがず
articles.summary: エクアドル漁船が米国軍に爆破され、漁師が生活の糧を失う中、人道上の懸念が浮上。しかし、マルコ・ルビオ米国務長官は、必要であれば船舶を爆破する用意があると述べ、トランプ政権の姿勢は揺るがないことを示唆しました。

articles.title: Lula bans fixed-odds sports betting a week before Brazilian elections
articles.description:
President’s ‘hard, drastic and necessary measure’, likely to attract widespread public support, polls suggest
The Brazilian president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has signed an order banning fixed-odds sports betting just over a week before the first round of the presidential election, in a move he said was designed to tackle the pervasive problem of families falling into debt.
The decision ends the operation, offering, intermediation and advertising of betting.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ルーラ大統領、ブラジル大統領選挙の1週間前に固定オッズ型スポーツ賭博を禁止
articles.summary: ブラジルのルーラ大統領は、選挙を1週間後に控え、家族の借金問題に対処するため、固定オッズ型スポーツ賭博の禁止命令に署名しました。この決定は幅広い国民の支持を得ると予測されています。

articles.title: The War in the Sky: Kyiv braces for another winter of Russian attacks
articles.description: A Euronews documentary goes inside Ukraine’s battle to defend its skies, from air-defence crews battling Russia’s drone threats to workers repairing the damage and families preparing for another winter of attacks.
articles.titleJa: 空の戦争：キーウはロシアの攻撃が続く冬に備える
articles.summary: ウクライナのキーウがロシアからの空襲が続く冬に備える中、防空部隊の戦い、被害修復、市民の冬支度など、ウクライナの防空の様子を追ったドキュメンタリー。

articles.title: Bardella hits back at Macron over antisemitism allegations
articles.description: The far-right National Rally party's Jordan Bardella has denied being the author of antisemitic messages attributed to him by investigative outlet Mediapart, which were published on Monday.
articles.titleJa: バルデラ氏、マクロン氏の反ユダヤ主義疑惑に反論
articles.summary: フランスの極右政党国民連合のジョルダン・バルデラ党首は、自身に帰属された反ユダヤ主義的なメッセージの作成を否定し、マクロン大統領からの疑惑に反論した。

articles.title: European preference in defence is a 'luxury' debate, NATO chief tells Euronews
articles.description: NATO chief Mark Rutte told Euronews the European preference debate is a "luxury" since neither Europe nor the US can meet the growing demand for defence products and the industry should ramp up its capacity.
articles.titleJa: NATO事務総長、防衛における欧州優先は「贅沢な」議論だとユーロニュースに語る
articles.summary: NATO事務総長は、防衛製品への高まる需要に対し欧米いずれも満たせないため、欧州優先の議論は「贅沢」であり、産業は生産能力を増強すべきだと述べた。

articles.title: Macron backs Spain over Ceuta migration crisis and urges firm EU action
articles.description: Sánchez and Macron back cooperation between Spain and France and call for greater EU unity on migration, economic and geopolitical issues, despite the Spanish Senate's rejection of the bilateral Friendship Treaty.
articles.titleJa: マクロン大統領、セウタ移民危機でスペインを支持し、EUの断固たる行動を促す
articles.summary: マクロン仏大統領はセウタでの移民危機に関してスペインを支持。スペインとフランス間の協力強化と、移民、経済、地政学的問題におけるEUの団結を訴えた。

articles.title: Qatar and UAE back Ethiopian government as fighting spreads beyond Tigray
articles.description: Fighting has displaced an estimated 150,000 people, drawing responses from Qatar and the UAE as Ethiopia and its neighbours trade accusations.
articles.titleJa: カタールとUAE、戦闘がティグレ州以外にも拡大する中、エチオピア政府を支援
articles.summary: 戦闘がエチオピアのティグレ州以外にも拡大し、約15万人が避難。カタールとUAEがエチオピア政府を支援する一方、エチオピアとその周辺国は互いに非難している。

articles.title: Uzeyir Hajibeyli festival celebrates a lasting musical legacy
articles.description: Uzeyir Hajibeyli’s musical legacy continues to bring different traditions together, inspiring an international festival spanning concerts, culture and musical exchange.

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes

articles.title: The Frenemy: How Australia navigates superpower rivalry
articles.description: Australia is increasingly concerned about China's military might - but Beijing is also its biggest trade partner.

articles.title: John H. Jackson Moot Court Competition kicks off with webinar support on offer

articles.title: WTO members deepen discussions on trade and climate measures, share updates
articles.description: The Committee on Trade and Environment (CTE) met on 28-29 September to advance its discussions on the trade and environment nexus, focusing on interoperability and development aspects of trade-related climate measures. Members also built on the voluntary information sharing exercise launched earlier this year with a view to enhancing transparency of trade and climate measures in the Committee. In addition, they were briefed on work undertaken in other international fora and on developments in several member-led environmental initiatives at the WTO.
articles.titleJa: WTO加盟国、貿易と気候変動対策に関する議論を深め、最新情報を共有

articles.title: New Zealand advances safe and inclusive trade with new contribution to STDF

articles.title: WTO, Asian Development Bank and World Bank bring TS4D initiative to Asia and the Pacific
articles.description: The WTO, the Asian Development Bank and the World Bank Group jointly organized a regional conference in Manila on 28-29 September that brought for the first time the Trade in Services for Development (TS4D) initiative to the Asia-Pacific region. The event allowed trade officials and other stakeholders from the region to discuss the role of services trade in development, exchange views on the use of analytical tools developed under the initiative and share best practices and policy approaches for supporting services trade in the region.

articles.title: Panel to review EU carbon border adjustment mechanism and emissions trading scheme

articles.titleJa: EU炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度を審査するパネルが設置へ

articles.title: Members review farm policies in first meeting under new Chair
articles.description: At a meeting of the WTO Committee on Agriculture on 24-25 September, WTO members addressed matters raised regarding implementation of their commitments and members' specific notifications. They also discussed a counter-notification submitted by Australia on India's support policies for sugar and heard a briefing on the global state of farming from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This was the first meeting under the new Chair, Mr William Horgan of Ireland.
articles.titleJa: 新議長の下での初会合で、加盟国が農業政策を審査

articles.title: WTO members review agriculture negotiation history, discuss ways forward

articles.title: A critical juncture for the world trading system: what the evidence tells us
articles.description: The multilateral trading system has underpinned a nearly 50-fold expansion of world merchandise trade volume and one of the most remarkable periods of economic growth and development in modern history, yet global trade policy and the WTO are experiencing the most serious and sustained disruptions since the system was created 80 years ago.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易システムの重大な岐路：証拠が示すもの

articles.title: Tariffs applied by WTO members have decreased by a third since 1996
